purpose: Freeze the single Campaign119 joint range-boundary direction-state entropy definition, source, ordered no-return gates, complete finite comparison boundary, one development trial, execution assumptions and stop rules before opening Campaign119 values.

candidate.name: intraday_range_boundary_direction_state_entropy_238p
candidate.economic_hypothesis: A broader distribution of joint lower/upper intraday auction-boundary direction states may represent adaptive two-sided price discovery and replenishment rather than a repetitive one-sided or nested range regime, carrying more resilience from the next open through the third close.

exact_formula.range_state: Use raw finite positive high and low with high greater than or equal to low at each bar. Zero-width bars and exact equal-boundary changes are valid; use no transform, scaling, winsorization, rounding, epsilon or imputation.
exact_formula.pair_rule: Within each 120-bar half separately, encode 119 adjacent pairs as (sign(delta low),sign(delta high)); never encode the lunch transition.
exact_formula.probability_rule: Pool all 238 within-half states and set p_k=count_k/238 for the fixed nine states, retaining zero counts.
exact_formula.support: Require exactly 240 valid high/low bars, exactly 238 recognized states, nine nonnegative integer counts summing to 238, and a finite score in [0,1]; otherwise missing.

comparison_contract.direction_normalization: use every comparator's frozen score direction

ordered_no_return_gates.name: binding_source_snapshot_and_implementation_verification
ordered_no_return_gates.rule: Before source values, bind this protocol, a pure formula implementation, tests, raw source, joint-clean source and output paths. After publication verify every partition byte/frame hash, exact projection/grid/formula/support/range/count and aggregate dataset digest.

ordered_no_return_gates.name: structural_coverage_variation_and_capacity_before_comparator_values
ordered_no_return_gates.rule: On the immutable quality/current-listing base require median daily coverage >=0.95, P05 daily coverage >=0.90, P05 eligible names >=50, at least 200 non-overlapping three-signal-session cohorts, at least five observed years, finite values in [0,1], and at least 200 nonconstant cross-sectional sessions. Failure stops before comparator value, daily price or forward return.

ordered_no_return_gates.name: all_136_numeric_uniqueness_after_coverage_only
ordered_no_return_gates.rule: Compare in exact v107 numeric order with all 136 eligible numeric comparators. Each comparison requires at least 50 paired names per session and at least 100 qualifying sessions. Every absolute median daily average-tie Spearman rank correlation must be strictly below 0.8; insufficient overlap fails closed and no comparator may be removed.

finite_development_catalog_if_admitted.purge: Purge three signal sessions at every train/validation boundary; t+1 entry and t+3 exit must remain in the same partition.
finite_development_catalog_if_admitted.execution: Reuse the frozen one-factor next-open to third-close Top-3 engine, CNY 200000 board-lot pilot, quality/listing gates, amount-participation checks, 0/5/10/20bp stress grid, and survivor gates without override.
finite_development_catalog_if_admitted.stress_2024_2025: Open once for the whole campaign only if the sole trial survives every 2019-2023 development gate and a nonzero survivor record freezes the entire campaign; label it historically exposed quasi-out-of-sample. Otherwise leave it closed and unread.

next_action: Implement and synthetically test the exact formula without opening historical source values, then fingerprint-freeze code and tests before the one no-return snapshot build.
